problems.title: Two-jump integrator
problems.objective: evaluate a Stieltjes integral with two separated jumps
problems.statement: Fix 0<c<d<1 and let α(x)=0 for x<c, α(x)=A for c≤x<d, and α(x)=A+B for d≤x≤1. Prove that ∫_0^1 f dα=A f(c)+B f(d) for every continuous f.
problems.strategy: Refine a partition to contain c and d. Only the two intervals starting at the jumps have nonzero α-increments, so continuity of f controls their tags independently.
hints: Insert c and d into the partition; refinement does not change the candidate limit.
All increments of α vanish except the increments across c and d, which equal A and B.
Use uniform continuity to make |A||f(t_c)-f(c)|+|B||f(t_d)-f(d)| small, treating zero coefficients separately.
problems.solution: Take a partition containing c and d. Every α-increment is zero except the increment whose left endpoint is immediately below c, which is A, and the corresponding increment at d, which is B. Thus its Stieltjes sum is A f(t_c)+B f(t_d). When the mesh is below δ, both tags lie within δ of their jump points. Uniform continuity of f therefore gives |A||f(t_c)-f(c)|+|B||f(t_d)-f(d)|→0, uniformly over tags. Hence the integral exists and equals A f(c)+B f(d).

Uses one mesh threshold that controls both jump tags uniformly.
Concludes existence and the formula A f(c)+B f(d), including signed A or B.

problems.statement: Let E⊆ℝ be open and let f_n:E→ℝ be continuous. Suppose that for every compact K⊂E, Σ_n sup_{x∈K}|f_n(x)| converges. Prove Σf_n converges uniformly on each compact K and its sum is continuous on E.

problems.solution: Fix a compact K⊂E and apply the M-test with M_n=sup_K|f_n|; this gives uniform convergence on K. To prove continuity at x∈E, openness supplies δ>0 with [x-δ,x+δ]⊂E. This interval is compact, so the partial sums converge uniformly there. They are continuous, and the uniform-limit theorem makes their sum continuous at x. Since x was arbitrary, the sum is continuous on E.
